knowledge_batches.contents_summary: 50 vocabulary entries, 30 story conflicts, 20 concept packages — see CHANGELOG.md v2.9
knowledge_batches.notes: Story conflicts and structural data (patterns, hooks) don't carry religious-accuracy risk and can move to 'approved' on a normal editorial read. Vocabulary and concept entries that cite Islamic sources still need the same review as phase2/data/islamic/*.json entries before 'approved'. Note (added after external audit, v2.12): this batch has no output_package/ or examples/ folder by design — it's data added directly to phase2/data/islamic/, islamic_vocabulary.json, and phase3/knowledge/concepts/*.json, not an episode artifact. 'generated' status here means the data entries exist and are citation_verified/source_verified per-entry (see those files), not that a packaged folder exists — different from how episode entries in this same queue work. Verifiable via: total entry count and citation_verified/scholarly_reviewed counts in REPO_HEALTH_REPORT.md.

status_definitions.generated: AI has produced the content. Nothing has been human-checked yet.
status_definitions.reviewed: A human has read it for accuracy/quality and either flagged issues (stays at 'reviewed' with notes, cycles back to a corrected 'generated' state) or found it acceptable.
status_definitions.approved: A human has explicitly signed off — this is the only status that permits production/publication use.
status_definitions.blocked: execution_modes.md's BLOCKED MODE — Smart Fallback found no real evidence for any genuine adjacent story. Only missing_knowledge_report.md exists; no episode files were written. Not a failure state to fix by relaxing evidence standards — it's the correct outcome when nothing real is available.

rule: tools/package_episode.py and any publishing step must check this file's status for the given episode_id before treating a package as ready to upload. 'generated' or 'reviewed' status is not sufficient — only 'approved' is.
